name: Graduation Tassel With Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from soft tassel threads and high-quality wood, offering a meaningful, lightweight, and elegant graduation accessory.
    - Features a custom shape 1-layer wooden charm that adds a personalized and memorable touch to the graduation tassel.
    - Wooden charm thickness: 2mm, providing a lightweight yet durable structure for everyday display and keepsake use.
    - Comes with an easy-to-use hook for interchangeable charms and a convenient attachment.
    - Includes a jump ring that securely connects the charm to the tassel and allows flexible adjustment depending on the design.
    - The tassel is soft, smooth, and neatly finished for a polished graduation look.
    - Available in 5 tassel color variations: Red, Yellow, Black & Yellow, Green & Yellow, Navy & Yellow.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Total tassel length: 43 cm ~ 16.93 in
    - Tassel fringe length: 21 cm ~ 8.26 in
    - Hook size: 1.3 cm ~ 0.51 in
    - Wooden charm sizes:
                     +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
                     +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions of the wooden charm may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The wooden charm supports 1-sided printing for personalized names, graduation wording, school themes, or celebratory artwork.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a graduation tassel and a personalized keepsake accessory.
    - Designed to decorate graduation caps while adding a unique custom charm detail.
    - Easy to attach, remove, or interchange using the included hook and jump ring.
    - Suitable for graduation ceremonies, senior photos, celebration parties, and memory displays.
    - Perfect for preserving graduation memories in a creative and personalized way.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for graduates, students, classmates, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for kindergarten, high school, college, and university graduation celebrations.
    - Ideal for senior keepsakes, graduation party gifts, and commemorative accessories.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, class years, and milestone memories.
    - Great for photo props, ceremony accessories, and memorable graduation displays.
    - Adds a fun, personal, and celebratory touch to graduation day🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Graduation Tassel With Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
